evidence.witness_plan: Both witnesses commute east_home_1 -> workshop_1 via the west bridge approach on day 0. M7 must start from an intact pre-incident branch, enable recording, observe their npc_state and 20-tick observation cadence, and time the incident while both have unobstructed sight within view_radius (adjust staging if necessary). Have envoy remove supports and drop the tool through grounded actions, or script rotten-support failure; retain actual event/entity origin IDs and npc_testimony. These setup witnesses have NO claimed incident testimony.

bridge.decoration: Oak slab edging on the abutments only; the two walking lanes stay full blocks.

fair.active_marker: A normal lantern emits light whenever present; it has no lit property.

pedestrian_paths.shoulders: One-wide full-block gravel collar around the union of dirt-path rectangles, on land only.
pedestrian_paths.crosswalks: Each named place plus its four cardinal neighbours uses gravel; stone abutments are preserved.
pedestrian_paths.reason: PathBlock is 15/16 high and has no sturdy UP face for the existing move_to standability test.

payment_receipt.title: Bridge contract
payment_receipt.author: mayor

required_fields.transfer_ids: Nonempty array of actual integer transfer event IDs

payment_receipt.supersession: Signed books cannot be edited. Mayor takes the old contract out of records slot 0, signs a new writable book with the linked receipt on page index 1, and files it in slot 0. The new document provenance supersedes only the original linked contract; the setup alias remains its historical identity.

deviations: River extends to z=-160..159 (other construction stays within about +/-128) to prevent dry-land end bypasses inside the force-loaded area.
A two-high perimeter wall at x/z=-128 and 127 bounds bot walking: force-loading alone is not a movement boundary. It prevents routes around river ends in other loaded chunks.

The bridge has a submerged stone foundation at y=-62 under its 24 eastern deck cells, leaving water at y=-61 until repaired. The two western deck cells depend on the variant pillars or the new adjacent deck's visible west faces. This avoids hidden bank-side placement faces. The three water layers are interrupted locally. Slabs decorate abutments only; walking lanes stay clear.

Both dock decks are raised to y=-60, one block above the banks, rather than lowering the existing east port. The west tongue has a bank anchor at x=-7; the missing east tongue retains its stone foundation at y=-61 for grounded repair. Ferry board coordinates name support blocks; moors use y=-60.5 inside the top water layer.
Long bot journeys use ford waypoints because move_to caps paths at 256 waypoints and 20000 expansions; the NPC road planner has no such cap.

Two-wide dirt-path carriageways have full-block gravel shoulders and small gravel crosswalks at named places. PathBlock's 15/16-height shape fails move_to's sturdy-UP support test; NPC road extraction alone would otherwise hide this bot-pathing failure.

Success predicates involving reports, incident classification, payment book fields and deadlines are data contracts for M7, not new control commands or an evaluator. Numeric welfare/profit/delivery targets are explicit scenario choices.
Evidence IDs are scenario labels and fixed entity UUIDs, not invented provenance IDs. Actual recorded collapse and witness origins are deferred to M7 as permitted by the spec.
The staged dropped tool has unlimited lifetime, avoiding vanilla despawn before an investigation; it remains normally collectable after a 10-tick pickup delay.

Recording=false is not a global audit mute: authored documents and NPC observation samples still log. Static blocks precede npc_setup and recording is enabled last; setup metadata records the incident boundary and actual document origins rather than deleting logs.

recording: Ordinary recording disabled throughout setup and its 100 settling ticks; enabled before final snapshot. Document/NPC logs still contain setup origins; use layout.setup as the boundary.
